contact.evidence_quote: “The school year has barely started and what we have seen from the Cristo Rey student workers is amazing,” said TRWD Human Resource Manager Shelby Lyon. “They are professional, smart, and up for any challenge we present to them.”

contacts.rung: Secretary / administration (last resort). Shelby Lyon is the Human Resource Manager who oversees the student work study program and manages the mentorship of students.

This committee is comprised of one member of the governing body (or an officer) from each Initial Contracting Party (City of Arlington, City of Fort Worth, City of Mansfield, and Trinity River Authority) and a member of the TRWD Board of Directors. The committee meets in February or March to discuss the District’s Capital Improvement Plan, review the annual audit, and discuss other matters pertinent to the committee. Each August or September the Committee meets to consider recommending the budge

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: TRWD provides water to 70+ customers across North Texas in an 11-county service area. Our taxing district, primarily centered in Fort Worth, was established in 1949 to fund the Fort Worth floodway. Click here to learn more about our tax rate.

network.coverage_note: The institution is a water district and not an educational institution, so it does not have Erasmus+ partnerships. The evidence lists local government and school partners for water supply and work-study programs.
